display_information.name: Bops
display_information.long_description: Bops gives your business a team of AI bots, each with its own computer, email and phone number. Add them to Slack like teammates: mention one in a channel, or send it a direct message, and it answers right here, with the work it does on its computer and in your apps. Each bot posts under its own name and picture. A bot takes requests only from the person who set it up, and asks them before it sends, posts or pays for anything.
